title: Should Have Learnt My Lesson By Now; No More Air India Flights For Me!
text:
Travelled with Air India in December for the first time in 6 years and did not find the service to have improved since the last time I flew with them. Our 9.30pm departure was delayed by 2 hours and they rushed the food trolley around, no drinks offered at all on this long haul flight aside from water which came with the meals. I was really looking forward to a glass or two of wine to help me sleep on this night flight, sadly it wasn't to be! DVD equipment was very poor both on outward and return journeys. Foot rests didn't stay up either on any of my flights so it was uncomfortable having to rest my feet on these on all flights. Cabin crew barely even check that passengers are wearing seat belts either, how slack! Food tray was dirty from previous flight and there were used tissues in the leaflet rack in front of me from the previous flight too, shocking stuff! 

Cabin crew were obviously in a hurry to get to sleep. Very young crying baby in front of me for 6 straight hours, not fun for the parents BUT definitely not fun for me or other nearby passengers either. Not one single member of staff came over to see if they could offer any assistance. Horrid experience at Delhi airport with other Air India flights from other places late as well and everyone who had an on-going flight was panicking going through the ridiculously slow and inefficient immigration and body search ALL over again (why they need to go through that all over again when you're in transit, who knows?!). No one from Air India even bothered with any advice or assistance to 100s of passengers freaking out thinking they were going to miss their onward flight. I just kept my calm as I knew my flight wouldn't be taking off without me and the dozens of other stuck in the queues. 

Return journey back to London was not much better, although it was on time. Cabin crew really are haughty, no matter how polite you are. Will avoid in future. Jew Airways and Virgin offer much better service according to others I know who travel to India regularly.

text:

The check in was smooth, friendly staff made the process nice and simple. On walking into the plane, I saw that it was clean and tidy, not run down like a few reviews on here have said. Leg room was sufficient, but the entertainment system is a bit outdated and needs to be a bit more varied. The food was nice, a choice of vegetable, Indian meat dish and continental meat dish. They all looked nice and the two that I had were lovely. The service was also very courteous and friendly. 
One annoying thing was, the flight attendants didn't clear up the rubbish during the flight so when we disembarked, we were trampling over rubbish to get out. 
All in all, it was a decent flight but I wouldn't rush back to Air India. Maybe I'd try first class to see what that experience brings.

title: Outstanding service from a truly caring airline
text:
Having previous good experience of travelling to the US by Air India on several occasions, I was happy to use them for a social trip to Punjab, India. What I did not realise at the time of selection was the extent to which we would be forced to lean on their 'good offices'. 

My wife had the misfortune to succumb to a stomach bug during the latter part of our trip and was feeling unwell as we started our return flight from Amritsar. By the time we reached Delhi, for an en-route top, she was clearly becoming seriously ill and after landing I requested the attendance of a doctor on the aircraft. The doctor asked that she be removed for the flight and my wide received excellent attention in the airport medical centre. Unfortunately her recovery caused us to miss re-embarkation of the aircraft by a few minutes. 

The ground staff at Delhi obtained permission for our (non-transferable) tickets to be re-validated for the following day at no charge and then arranged for us to stay overnight at the on-site hotel, again at no charge to us. I can imagine no other airline being equally caring and generous, based on my fairly wide experience, and I can do no other than recommend Air India very, very highly. To cap it all, our baggage arrived on the deferred flight with us - now that's real efficiency. A truly caring airline!

I noticed most people around me didn't have the juice - a small chocolate like a KitKat would be more welcoming I'm sure.

Staff were pleasant on this flight and had to be well organised given the brevity of it.

Would use Air India again, but it's not my preferred Indian airline.

Very pleasantly surprised with the level of service & of course very happy that we were able to get the bag.

title: Flight cancelled, very unhelpful staff
text:
We hadn't even entered the airport when we were told the once-a-day flight had been cancelled. Air India staff could not have been LESS helpful. First, they wouldn't let us up to the counter because we didn't have tickets. 

YES, you read that correctly. 

They would not entertain the notion that they should reroute us through Delhi or elsewhere. Every question we had was answered with "it's no problem." Well, clearly it was. 

After being shuffled about for two hours, they put us on a bus back to Varanasi and put us in a shady hotel, one that had no idea we were arriving. A terrible experience that cut our time in Nepal by a full day. 

Once we were flying, it was clear that the plane and its staff were not as good as the discount carriers like Kingfisher and Jet, which we had already flown. 

The plane even looked like it needed to be washed on the outside!

title: So rude to passengers
text: The staff are so unbelievably rude, if I could've got off the aircraft I would've. I'm a frequent flyer (this was my 11th and 12th flight since September) and I was disgusted at the poor service. To start with, when queuing up to board my flight in London there was a distressed gentleman who was asking for help but the staff shouted loudly and shooed him away in a humiliating and dismissive manner. Then halfway through the flight I was asleep and got woken up by cabin crew telling me I had to put my seat upright because they were bringing meals round (I've never had this before, they should've let me sleep). Then an elderly gentleman thought he heard a child crying in the toilet so alerted cabin crew. A staff member then opened the toilet lock without knocking first and discovered a male passenger inside who was annoyed he'd been barged in on so the flight attendant then stood there shouting at the elderly gentleman saying it's his fault she opened the door because he misinformed her! Both gentlemen looked embarrassed as she caused a scene. When I got up to ask for a drink cabin crew rolled their eyes at me as though it was a huge inconvenience even though they hadn't offered drinks for several hours. The aircraft was dirty and the carpet threadbare. The whole experience was absolutely awful and considering I've flown approximately 70 times with various airlines I would NEVER fly with Air India again. The entire crew from ground staff to cabin crew need to learn some manners and respect and certainly need to be trained in customer service.

title: Nightmare in the sky
text:
I last flew this airline many years ago when they were not the best airline. We planned this trip with family and somehow decided to try it again as we had heard that they had improved and thought we would give it a go. What a horrible experience. 

The Aircrafts are old , the seats worn and tatty.  The entertainment system does not work well. On one leg  of the flight, I knew several members of our group whose entertainment systems did not work. When the crew member was notified,his only response was to agree that it is not working. He did not offer to help in any way. 

The Crew: the worst customer service I have ever experienced on a flight. I couldn't understand this because India prides itself on amazing hospitality. Indeed, I have experienced this first hand whenever I stay at  Indian hotels. I have used other Airlines serviced by Indian staff like Jet Airways and Etihad, and the experience on those occasions were great. All I can say is that from my experience of Air India staff, they were a disgrace! One of our group asked for a soft drink and it took them 1.5 hours before they brought it. Dinner trays were left for at least 40 minutes before they were cleared, not because they were busy but because they couldn't be bothered. Having waited a long time to have her tray cleared and in spite of calling for assisitance several times when nobody arrived, my daughter finally took her tray back to the service area. She was surprised to see that the crew were not busy serving but were doing crosswords!! 

The Food: I am not a great fan of flight food but on one occasion they served a croissant with cheese that looked like it had been put together by a 3 year old.

Overall, one of those experiences I would never ever want to repeat even if they are the last airline left in the world!!  India can definitely do a lot better than this

title: Filthy toilets, poor service.

Within a couple of hours of departure the toilets became filthy and at no stage did cabin crew clean the toilets. After a 12 hr sector the situation was nothing short of revolting. It's puzzling how a relatively new aircraft (787) can already feel dilapidated in the hands of this airline.

If flying Air India I would advise you bring your own toilet paper and plenty of drinking water as very little of either is provided.

title: Comfortable Aircraft, Substandard Service
text:
Only a couple of positives in my review. The aircraft (Dreamliner) was very comfortable. It was clean and most importantly, the seats had more leg room than some of the more illustrious airlines flying Mumbai - Singapore route, including Singapore airlines. AI's Dreamliner had the best economy class seats I have seen in recent times. Secondly, the flight departed bang on time. (May be I was fortunate!).

Now coming to service, Air India has a long way to go before being compared with the good airlines in the world. A long long way to go, I would say. Here's why - 

1. Check in at Mumbai airport took a good 1 hour. They had just 1 check in row to cover all international flights departing from Mumbai (including a couple of counters for business class). Non separate counters for baggage drop for those who have pre selected their seats. On inquiry with the staff, I understand that it is very normal to have such long queues at their check in counters. This is definitely not acceptable!

2. The cabin crew obviously does not believe in 'service with smile' policy. A passenger seated besides me passed his coat to a cabin crew member to store in the rack during the flight. He was sternly told by the cabin crew member that he should 'remind' them (to return the coat) after the plane lands. The good airlines in the industry do not expect to be 'reminded' to do their duty! .... and when the passenger did remind the cabin crew members a few minutes before landing, he was told "why don't you collect it after the plane lands".... The cabin crew member has no business to pose a counter question to a passenger. If he has difficulty in returning the coat at that time, he should just say that he is unable to return the coat now because of ___.

3.  On all other overnight flights from Mumbai to Singapore, I have seen cabin crew move around with trays containing water/fruit juice. Lot of passengers do like to have a glass of water or juice after a couple of hours of sleep just prior to landing. Air India seems to have a 'water on demand' policy. If you want water, you have to call the cabin crew member. The lucky ones are served, or else, the cabin crew members conveniently ignore the requests.

AI's cabin crew service had always been their weak point. I travelled AI after a long gap and found that (sadly), their service still needs miles of improvement.

title: Unnecessary hassles in inbetween transfers
text:
I traveled on the Air India flight as part of my International trip from Surat, India to Denver via New Delhi, JFK, New York. I traveled by Air India upto JFK, NY and from there was booked on Delta on a single PNR. 

The in-flight experience in AI from Surat to Delhi on AI 490 and it was fine - this being an evening flight it was an Airbus 320 - a large aircraft that could accommodate my luggage.  The same in the flight from Delhi to JFK, NY i.e. AI 101 was also good - it was a sort of "overnight" journey - board at around 1:00 am and land at 07:00 am local times. 

The following could be useful to those aiming for similar travel:
1. When I checked in at Surat India, my two suitcases were thorough checked-in upto JFK, NY. The luggage check-in upto Denver was not possible, even though had a single PNR.  I must acknowledge that the airline officials at Surat were very cooperative and they tried all their means to see that the luggage is thorough checked-in - however  that was not possible. 
2. However, at JFK, NY, after I finished immigration and customs  immediately outside there was a counter of Delta through which I could checkin my luggage again. So even though my outbound flight from JFK, NY to Denver was from a different terminal, I did not have to actually carry the luggage with me, Simply drop the luggage at the Delta counter and then proceed to the terminal to collect the boarding pass. This was a great relief, though thorough check-in of the luggage upto Denver would have been great. 
3. One of the strange aspect for the flight 101 originating from Delhi is that, one has to do security check TWICE - first the routine security check at the airport and then one more AT THE GATE. This is the first time ever, I experienced such dual security checks. So one muse be prepared for the unnecessary hassles !!

Thanks.

I must have tried the numbers atleast 20 times.
I think its highly unprofessional of Air India. The staff and management are bringing huge shame to the nation.

title: Nice..........!
text: This is my first journey with Air-india. Services in International flight is wonderful. Foods are also very nice. Ground staffs are also very helpful. But one of the major problem is time. Domestic flights are not in time very often. I have also traveled in Business class with air-india in domestic flight and there is not much differences with the economic one. Price in the domestic transfer is quite high compared to the other airlines in India.

title: Good airline
text: I had to travel in this airline only as my daughter was  on official duty and she had to travel only in this airline. Though the staff are in ethnic dress the comfort and legroom in this airline I found is much better than other operators.  the food served is also ok and overall comfort is good. When I travelled it was little costly than the other private operators. If i get an offer I would not hesitate to travel with them again.

title: comfortably numb
text: Air India economy was a bit better than expected. There was a priority line for boarding if you were business or had a Star Alliance loyalty card, there was more leg room than some European airlines on domestic flights, the seats bearable and there was food, though dominated by carbohydrates and sugar. All the luggage arrived and flights in both directions were pretty much on time. The crew was patient and helpful, and the passengers were co-operative in packing away baggage. Not too bad at all.

title: You get what you pay for.
text: I found this airline to be rather outdated and not great customer service. The food was to be desired and the entertainment was rather poor. I feel the entire airline is in need of a rebrand and modernisation.

title: Not customer focused prior to flight. Tatty and cramped, problems with inflight films.
text: Flight times were changed at short notice by airline, with limited options for refund or decent alternative - all stacked against the customer - terrible customer service which meant huge stopover time for return trip, which increased day before. I travelled out with them and it was not a great experience, the inflight films were not working properly on our row and every time they tried to reset it I had to start my film again - about 7 times. Everything a bit shabby and food wasn't that great either. Couldn't bear the thought of flying back with them so flew back with Oman Air - it was like first class in comparison. Avoid Air India if you can and if you need reliable flight times.

title: Awful flight - never again!
text: I thought I would give Air India a try as it was a cheap flight but soon regretted it. Three hours into an eight hour flight the toilets were so disgusting they were not useable. One was blocked and stank, the other also smelt horrible and the lid kept falling down on your back when you sat on the seat. Both had run out of toilet paper. I informed the surly cabin stewards who advised nothing could be done until we were on the ground.  Great - crossed legs for five hours then. The food was passable but not great and my seat was also broken and would not recline. The cabin steward did his best but could not fix it. I spent the whole flight sitting upright and couldn't sleep. The in flight entertainment was pathetic with the highlight of available films being Gone with the Wind. I honestly couldn't get off that awful flight quickly enough. Never again.

title: Best Journey
text: One of my best flight journeys with extra comfort. the journey was amazing. the services were amazing. i arrived before time. the food was delicious.

title: NIGHTMARE
text:
He most unreliable air line I have ever flown with. I will never fly with them ever again!
We flew from Goa to Mumbai to Delhi to Hong Kong. Every stop had 2 to 3 hours delay with no advice of why there was a delay.

title: Decent airline with total Indian feel but improvement needed
text: I took a round trip ticket to India with my wife and the experience was quite different each way.  The food was quite good, both veggie and otherwise, and we may be biased coz we love Indian food.  The seat was decent, and the service was all right.  The price was relative good. However, my wife had a malfunction console, and the video programming can get more non-Indian shows.  I may consider taking Air India again when I travel on a budget.

title: Timing is not the best, but
text: Not the most punctual airline, but the travel is comfortable and the food is awesome. Sometimes it resembles an Indian train, but that's because people.

title: Good experience
text: It was nice experience. I was forced to buy this ticket as this was the only flight matching the time which I wanted. However, after travel I can confirm that the authorities have taken quite pain in revamping the airline. Delay of flight is still a problem, but comfort wise and in house food service is quite good.

title: Very nice -Recovery of Indian National Airline- Happy to note turn around in service , quality of flight , comfort
text: I travelled from Delhi- my travel organisers arranged Air India flight- My experience while travelling was great and more than expected

title: Pampered
text:
Right from the first minute , the air hostesses started taking care of us. We were offered a choice of drinks in the beginning including champagne. 
then we had nuts and alchoholic drink. after that snacks, then dinner, cheese palette, fruit platter and then desserts. 
We were offered pajamas for the overnight flight...very comfortable
multi media experience was good with varied choices
food was excellent
did not realise how the 8 hour flight get over...was pampered from the very first moment until landing. 
Also received a nice pouch with utiities as a gesture. 
Will certainly fly again

title: Definite Improvement
text:
Check-in was smooth at Ahmedabad airport. We were checked in through to BKK. The short flight was comfortable. Service was fine. From DEL (where we transited) to BKK the Dreamliner was in operation. It's a very comfortable aircraft and service was excellent. Only thing I noted there didn't seem to be any effort to promote onboard duty free sales. Perhaps there was none.
Check-in at BKK was also smooth. There was some irritation evident in the lady checking us in when we requested notation of our FFP nos but she did do it. Dreamliner again. Service excellent. No duty free evident again.
Earlier I've had multiple bad experiences with Air India reassigning the seats on second legs of connecting journeys. This time we had the seats we had reserved. One major grouse removed! In the last few years I've flown Etihad and Quatar. Cabin service on Air India is definitely better, at least in Economy. The vegetarian meals are at par. I'm thing of switching over exclusively to Air India, route and fares permitting.

title: Correct, but nothing more
text: We have several flights to go to and come back from Kathmandu via Delhi. First, there were several changes for the time schedule between reservation and departure. Then, there is no agreement between Thalys and Air India, and finally, there are several hours between Thalys' arrival and possibility for checking, and inversely. Once in the plane, the screen did not work, the tablet was partially broken, etc But hostesses were nice. When I came back from Kathmandu with AI214, because of changing plane schedule, there was no time for the next flight AI143: once arrived, the gate was already closed. Because we were several,int he same condition, we got it but it was really not easy for me to run from one gate to the other. But, luggages arrived until Paris in spite of the short time between both flights. Air India was quite better several years ago.

title: Dreamliner is really a dream.
text:
This experience is WOW !!! on the new Dreamliner...

Specious, very courteous staff , excellent choice of food. Completely flat seats to relax.

title: More about the passengers
text: Whilst the beautiful new plane seemed dated in look and the staff were good, in all my flights the fellow passengers were the issue. The passengers on this airline expect that they can push and shove to get on and then sit in whatever seat they like to be with friends and families. The passengers then expect you to find another seat. The flight attendants are not overly helpful with this and spend a lot of time trying to negotiate with people instead of just directing people to their assigned seat. Food was only ok with bread and croissants stale. I am unlikely to choose this airline again! There were also many screaming children on my flights and it seemed they screamed the entire journey without respite. Too many younger kids without seats!

title: Excelllent Flight and Service
text: Flew from Birmingham to Delhi twice over the summer months. Excellent flights on the Dreamliner. Very quiet engines and superb mood lighting. Cabin crew very attentive and food very good. There were no delays on any of the flights we took and we even arrived 45 minutes early on one flight into Delhi. Would certainly recommend Air India.

title: Right from web-checkin to boarding, everything was bad
text:
I did a webcheckin and when reached the airport, realized that Air India doesnt have a separate queue for checked-in passengers. Waited in the long queue where only 3 counters were open. When I reached the counter, I was told that my seats do not exist and would need to be changed as they have now changed the air craft. Funny part was my colleague who had a similar seat was already given the boarding pass. when I informed them, he was given a new boarding pass.

As I had a connecting international flight, I was wrongly sent thru domestic departure rather than taking the international transfer because of which I faced further problems. Avoid Air India as the staff is not professional.

The flight landing was the roughest I have ever encountered.

title: Disappointing as Air India is part of the Star Alliance
text: expected Air India to be better.  We were over an hour late departing - due to a passenger loosing their passport.  However we were not kept informed of the delay - just expected to sit and wait.  The stewardesses looked like they wished they were somewhere else and the food served was again - hardly exciting.  The baggage took over 45 minutes to arrive in the baggage claim area. Entertainment was also poor- only offering movies at least 10 years old

title: Very bad experience
text: Will never fly again with air india very bad customer service not happy i will pay more and better fly with qatar airlines.mainly customer service in nepal is awful if you ring their office they will never answer your phone call .I had more than 8hrs transit they dint offer me hotel to stay will never fly with this airline again

title: Good experience in Air India Flight
text: We traveled to and fro from Vizag to New Delhi in Air India.  Flight arrived 15 minutes late. Overall the experience is good and even the breakfast is ok. Overall its a nice flight experience especially during take off from Vizag Airport

title: Air India

title: It was an awesome experience flying with AIr India
text: Although it was the first time for me to Fly with Air India , but their courteous staff made it a pleasant Journey :)

title: Much Improved Services and good value for money
text: Air India has improved its services, in flight services and on time performance over the years, due to better legroom & bigger aircraft its a better choice than many Airlines operating in India

title: I support our national carrier
text: I took a small flight from Kolkata to Ranchi. I have heard a lot of negative things about Air India but my experience was nothing but perfect. title: National Career yet far from Improvement
text: Its a National Career but services are far from satisfactory.  Total Indifferent attitude. However aircraft are good. sufficient leg rooms. good catering.

title: Not a good service
text: I travelled to Jodhpur for family trip this year from Pune. but there is no connectivity directly from the city. All you have to travel is either from Pune or Pune - Delhi - Jodhpur connecting flight. The service provided by Air India was not good. Specially the food quality was bad. Also the fares are quite high as compared to other domestic airlines. Air India should learn from other countries govt. airlines how they manage and how they handle the customers. Too much improvement is necessary and also the city like Pune should be connected with all major cities of India.

title: Good Experience with this Airlines
text: We are opt to go to see  Andaman Island and for that we have flied by Air India from Kolkata to Port Blair.The flight is very good and the coo member & attendant are also very good and they specially care my baby who is then less of two years.

title: Has potentials to rise...
text: Travel experience is average. Up-to booking stage is good but cost are higher, staff can be more courteous, being on time is important & more number of direct flights especially with government support can make the travel experience good.

title: Great new planes but the same useless mentality & people running it
text:
Mon 31st Oct 2016: checked as per usual and once at gate we were informed of a small delay which turned out to be 4 hours plus. On arrival at Delhi they told everyone that the suitcases have been left behind and that they will be delivered to our destinations within 2 days. 1 week later and still no suitcases, the help desk in India & UK have no idea and are very keen to pass the buck to another department. 

Why did they invest millions in new Boeing Dreamliners when they can't run a local bus company, when will they instal someone at the helm who gives a damn about the  traveler, why do they have this corrupted mentality that no one can accept any  responsibility ??????? 

Sadly i can see this flight dying from Birmingham (UK) as the stories we hear on a regular basis won't let it survive. Air India needs to wake up and listen, this can be one of the most lucrative routes from the UK to India. 

Let me run your UK operations, I promise I can turn it around in 2-3 years to a real money maker... in fact let my 11 year old run the operation, he'll do a far better job in turning this circus comedy into a business that travellers can trust & enjoy for many years to come.

Shame on you Air India....

title: best service ever
text:
great experience with air India.....co operative cabin crew, safe flight with cheap rate..
safe and trusted flight

title: Nothing much to write home about
text: The flight was an hour delayed to start with..the plane due to high altitude restrictions was smaller not the smallest though..ATR 62...with a capacity of 70....check in was fast , the staff courteous..transit to the plane was by bus...boarding was without a hitch...the taxi to the start of the runway seemed to last a lifetime sometimes giving one the feel that this flight might take us to the destination on wheels only...the take off was splendid and so was the landing..the pilot a foreigner was courteous and polite and communicated well with us..the view from the windows was breathtaking over the Himalayas...you could spot Shimla and Chail clearly....after the flight a temperature of 10 deg greeted us at Bhuntar..lovel view ..before i forget the snack meal on board was horrible to say the least...all forgotten after landing at the paradise of Himachal..Bon Voyage

title: awesome experience
text:
Air India flight from delhi to bengaluru offered vast services. we were given personalized screen and headphones. seats were comfortable.
food was also good.
overall value for money!!

title: Not up to expected standards
text:
Smooth check in and boarding of the plane but the plane was dirty , the seats , the windows everything . The food served was average and there is no entertainment
at all not good for a 5hr flight . We had one 50 minute stop over and passengers going on to Male had to stay on board while the cleaners , security etc checked and cleaned ( sort of ) the interior . The attendants ignored the call button requests but were friendly. The only real possitive was the legroom t was good . Would I fly with them again only if there was no other option

title: Terrible experience
text: Terrible experience. Flight delayed. Airport authorities and customer service clueless on connecting flight. Well, I traveled through Air India 7 years ago and decided never to travel with Air India again. I wish I had followed my own decision. I regret again today for booking through Air India. In all the other years of travel - we did not have such bitter experience through any other airlines. Hopeless Air India!!!!!

title: Feel like home
text:
I have travelled many time through Air india,
Mostly from delhi to seoul or seoul to delhi While on Business trip.
It always feel like home while travelling.
All the crew members are cooperative and helpful.
They always have a smile on their faces.
Food is also very delicious and healthy.
I always prefer to book Air india for my Journey.

title: looks better than before
text:
i flew Air India thrice last month. first kathmandu to delhi and then delhi-colombo-delhi.

the services of the flag carrier of  india looked improving to match other private carriers.

though they need more to do on punctuality part. my flight got delayed byalmost an hour. the check in was smooth. on board services was impressive. we were first served drinks and then lunch on the 3 hour flight to colombo.
there were nothing for on board entertainment except some reading materials. cleanliness was good. seats and leg room on the airbus 321 was satisfactory.

the mid flight info given by captain was interesting.. flight was turbulence free. take off and landing was nice.

overall experince on the flight was quite satisfacory.

title: In time, best domestic travel so far
text: Well, after flying hundreds of time domestically, this is by far one of my best domestic flying experience. AI offered a new dream liner aircraft for this flight which  was in excellent condition, clean, TV monitors working and good food with very efficient air hostesses and gentlemen. Very different to regular AI service we are use to.

title: Safety clearly not a priority
text: Travelled in October on the new Dreamliner aircraft.  Pleasant meals and reasonably comfortable.  On time with departure and arrival.  Check in was great. HOWEVER I sat in 12 d, on take off a young mum and her mum were travelling with a very small baby were sitting opposite me, on take off baby was placed on a pillow and lay down on 2 tray tables. No seat belt, got worse during flight with a help your self drink station being provided but put over the exit door, oh yes I should have taken photos, on decent, minimal seat belts worm, bags everywhere on floor by feet and baby on tray table again.  I am not used to this level of casualness. Extremely concerning and probably will  not fly with this airline again.

title: Must take while coming back home
text: Air India is my favorite airline,earlier I had only one reason to travel with air India and that was it is the only airline which allows to carry 25 kg luggage. but now I have one more reason.I am a frequent flyer and I do not like the food which is being served in the fight.I believe that all airlines are at par for not being able to serve tasty food except Air India. Recently I traveled from Delhi to Bhopal although it was a small aircraft but they served a nice and tasty breakfast. The crew was very nice and friendly.They gave me a blanket to cover when I felt cold.This is a kind of luxury only AirIndia provides.

title: Well, the name has it
text: had an amazing experience on my visit to nepal so overall i would consider flying on this airline. not all are same and not all provide the same or equal experience so you can check out once

title: Back to home Mumbai
text: Air India always Delay problem, No in flight Entertainment ,Air india Airbus flight from jaipur to mumbai good service,Air india meal was awsome thumsup,nice flight reched mumbai 05 Mins Early :D

title: Its OK for Domestic
text:
I travelled from Tirupati to Hyderabad by Air India flight. Since I did not have much expectations about this flight, I did not face any problem as far as my flight journey is considered. I was returning to Hyderabad on 12th October after the Brahmotsavam at Tirumala,  This flight I choose because, it was a very convenient for me for my time slot. 

The flight came about 15 minutes late to Tirupathi airport and so our Boarding was delayed for about 15 minutes, which I consider it as a minor. The flight was neat. It took off at 14.40 hours and the journey to Hyderabad was covered in less than One hour. some snacks were served during the journey. This is a good gesture. In other flights, nothing is served in Domestic flights except for sale.

Though I have not travelled much in Air India Flights either in Domestic or International, this part of my jouney from Tirupati to Hyderabad is considered as average.

title: A good journey with Air India
text: Good journey in Dreamliner, sky was a bit cloudy, but other than that everything was fine. Departure and arrival was smooth. Food was good as well.

title: AIR INDIA has the nicest staff out of all Airlines.
text:
I fly Air India's 787 Dreamliner business class a lot and it's always a great way to fly. At first when i boarded my flight the seat was not cleaned properly, I complained and immediately the staff came and got it cleaned thoroughly. I flew a day before my Birthday and in order to compensate for the inconvenience they gave me a Nice Bottle of Champagne as a present and wished me. I always get friendly with the staff on Air India because they are so warm and nice and treat passengers very well.

Honestly Air India is not the best cabin but its very comfortable , the food is excellent and staff attitude is what tops it all. I have flown business and first class on many other carriers and often had to deal with cold, arrogant and uptight staff who get irritated easily if you ask for anything but in Air India no matter how many times you ask for something, you will always get it with a SMILE.

Ok National Carrier of India, its reasonably good one, provided everything goes alright,  I traveled twice in a short span of 10 days in the same flight. During the first trip all went smooth and in the second trip, at DXB terminal 1 there was confusion about the boarding gate and no one to guide. As there was no announcement there were some tense moments , then everything ended well. Sometimes the price is too much and some times it is very affordable, if you intend to travel by AI then keep monitoring the price on the web and book.

title: Worth Trying
text: I have to fly to US urgently to meet a family commitment. My experience with Air India had been very good. I could leave India within Fifteen Hours of my Decision. The Fares paid by me was reasonable and not high as charged by Most. I had a very good Seat. The best part is the Flight lands at Chicago at 0800 hours giving you full day.  The Flight from Delhi is non stop. In Flight Service is good.

title: Much Improved Airline
text: Air India is one of the most improved airline I have seen in recent times. Though it was short flight from Amritsar to Delhi but it was good. Though it still needs to improve on cleanliness and better staff behaviour. I enjoyed my flight to Bangkok recently in May a lot. Actually every Indian wants Air India to improve. Good keep the good work goind and polish the corners.

title: Miserable cabin crew, poor service and running 3 hours late
text: Having arrived at New Delhi with 5 hours to spare before our flight it was then announced that there would be a delay of 3 hours, the only information we had was that the idiot security guards needed to stamp our boarding passes for the second time!! What a joke of an airline

title: Not there yet
text: The aircraft is either old or not maintained properly. Nothing worked properly, let it be seat push back, entertainment system or headphones. Flight attendants were friendly. Quality and taste of food served on board is decent.

title: AGood Experience
text: This was my first flight in Air India after nearly Five Years. This was my connecting flight to Delhi from Where I was flying to Chicago. The Experience at Chennai is normal though Airport leaves much to, be desired. Immigration was done at Chennai and my Luggage was booked to Chicago. A Major Plus Point. The Flight was not crowded and  Food ( Vegetarian ) was passable. The Cabin Crew Pleasant  and sometimes wonder why so much adverse publicity about Air India.

title: Air India on their Dreamliner from Mumbai to Singapore
text:
Apart from the good legroom in economy and the extra baggage allowance (30kgs in economy), everything felt sub standard.  The check in was efficient.  The flight was delayed by almost 3 hours.  At the gate, there was no regular information given about the delay.  The staff attitude was one of not caring about the passengers at all.  Seemed like they were just whiling away their time in order to complete the shift.  On pressing by a few passengers, they put up a board saying "DELAY DUE TO TECHNICAL REASONS".  Seems like their standard reply.  Luckily the flight was only delayed and not cancelled otherwise it would have been a nightmare with the ground staff attitude.

After boarding, the meal served was prompt but was very average.  The airline crew was also not bothered to greet the passengers at all and had a poor attitude about their jobs.  After the meal service, no crew was seen till about 15  minutes to landing when they offered water to anyone who cared to ask.

title: Air India London Heathrow to Ranchi
text: Flight from London to Delhi.  Departed on time. Not too crowded. Usual flight conditions. Vegetarian (Choice) meals were good served efficiently with a smile. Cleared away quickly. Encouraged to sleep asap. Uneventful. Arrived Delhi bit early. Now the problems start due to long wait at airport for connecting flight to Ranchi. Picking up baggage efficient and quick. Plenty of wheelers available. Not allowed to proceed to Domestic Departure area until 4 hours before flight so had to spend 12 hours in Arrival area. Lounges were all full in sleeping area (only 20 rooms available). Spent the time sitting in Coffee Bar areas and walking around. Didn't feel safe to sleep with baggage. Lots of armed security personnel and police on duty, many protected by bullet-proof shields. Toilet facilities adequate but for the lone traveller no place to leave baggage except take into toilet area which is crowded. Eventually allowed into Domestic Departure area. Check-in was quick and efficient. Security checks completed OK. Departure Area offered more comfort. Departure was delayed due to late arrival. Food fine. Uneventful but crowded flight. Arrived Ranchi on time. Baggage collection slow but OK. Overall, fine flight but connection at Delhi too slow. Best option to spend couple of days in Delhi to avoid long delay in airport.

title: Worst experience... letting India Down
text:
Worst experience again, traveling with air India is just like a night mare for me .worst service, airport staff in Thailand ready to help but Indian staff in airline is worst , no respect, 5-6 time only airlines checking , I haven't seen this number of checking in any part of the world, definitely will not come back , my flight was at 8:50 delayed by 4 hours no reason was informed only 350 bhat breakfast vouchers was given as compensation. Definitely please don't go if you go please ready for night mare .
Other flight give you nice experience and you can enjoy.

title: You get what you pay for......
text:
First time flying with Air India, though its the first time I have ever taken a internal flight in any country.
What can I say really?, I flew from Ahmedabad to Mumbai, economy class which took and hour and 15 minutes, the plane was 22 minutes late taking off, the seats are not the most comfortable, although surprisingly we were given a drink and some food, which I wasn't expecting based on the length of the flight, totally unexpected but a nice gesture all the same.
I got off the plane, collected my luggage, one of my cases was badly damaged, it looked like it had been thrown about as it was scratched up too - just bear this in mind if and when travelling with them.

title: Average
text:
Flight Cancelled.
27th Sept 2016 21:30 flight. Arrived at airport to be told Flight cancelled...... Check in desk gave a £7.50 food voucher with offer for a Hotel or pay taxi fare home. 
Took Taxi home. Check in Staff informed us after taking passenger details that they would contact passengers with details of next days flight. 
NO CALLS FROM UK AIR HANDLER. 
I made many calls to Air India to check on flight details, Takeoff time given varied from midday next day to 13:30 , Checked in next day 2 hours before 13:00 flight . Eventually took off at 16.30. 
NO INFORMATION ON DEPARTURE BOARD, LIMITED INFORMATION AFTER CHECKIN. 
ANYBODY ELSE STILL WAITING FOR COMPENSATION, WILL WE GET ANY? 
Generally an OK airline but next time ( Nov 2016) I'm going with EMIRATES... 
AI cabin crew Nice enough but nothing special, 
The seat I had NO IFE. 
MOVED SEATS STILL NO IFE, GOOD JOB I HAD MY IPOD. 
Not Impressed

title: A cheap and pleasant surprise
text:
I try to stick to Star Alliance due to status benefits and saw this flight on Kayak.  It was showing as nearly half the rate of Asiana running the same route so I thought i would give it a go.

The times are very convenient and since it is a continuation flight the leg between HK and Seoul at least on my flight was not more then 50% full.  I don't think most people know about it.  The plane is a 787 and is quite comfortable.  I skipped food service as the outbound flight is early and ate at the United Lounge in HK and the return flight is mid afternoon so no need to eat. 

Will definitely do it again!

title: Phone was stolen from checked bag
text: They stole my phone, worst customer service, bad food. Flight was late 2 hours. Disorganized unprofessional mess.

title: Not interested in their customers
text: Flight to India, Delhi last December. The outbound flight was good, but we had three flights home. Goa to Mumbai, Mumbai to Delhi, then Delhi to Heathrow. All 3 flights were delayed and we missed the last connection and had towait of 12 hours. The customer service was minimal, and on returning I have complained to them, and nearly a year later have not had a satisfied response. I have even e mailed the CEO. So my experience of Air India us one of great disappointment. I will not fly with them again.

title: Going pits
text: The airline has got a lot of drumming for the most uninspiring service over the years and air India has done sweet little about it. The service now coupled with the food on board is absolutely pathetic.  I complained to the flight attendent abt the quality and asked him to give me a feedback form which he conveniently forgot and when I went to the rear of the cabin I found the staff busy on their mobiles,  sitting with legs stretched on the door; ala office babu class. The flight announcements were almost inaudible, unsure and the english language was ripped apart. We certainly need to project a better picture of the national airline. After a chaotic checkin experience at the bagdogra airport followed by the on board service by the air India staff, I am convinced that the national carrier is the pits.

title: Comfortable direct light to USA
text: A direct flight from New York which takes least time. No lay offs . Ample soft drinks and snacks through out the flight. In flight entertainment available particularly hindi films. Indian meals. will be liked by Indians.

title: average fly company
text: An average fly company no special food, beverages or service everything only as expected, so i will only recommend it as a need to flight company

title: GLIDE ABOVE THE CLOUDS IN SHEER LUXURY
text:
Feel like sharing my great experience with the Air India recently.  I always felt that our national carrier is not getting its due share of appreciation.  Air India has certainly changed for the better.  
I took AI 307 from Narita, Japan to Delhi on the 22nd October.  The Japanese staffs who were handling the check-in counter were very courteous and eager to help the passengers.  In a crowded air line check-in counter there are always passengers who lose their patience.  The check-in counter of  AI 307 was not different.  The staff, however, was very polite and attended to all passengers with their inherent politeness.  Air India apparently does not have its own lounge in Narita and AI passengers are handled by Air China.  The lounge overlooking the runway is well furnished.  It  had a fairly good stock of food and beverages.
The best part was the service on board and the flight in itself.  The crew on board Ms Achla, Ms Shagufta and Ms Saito were extremely courteous and equally efficient at the same time maintaining true professionalism.  Every need of the passengers were anticipated and met very promptly.  The starters, the main course of lunch and the snacks in the afternoon were all delicious and presented matching to or even surpassing the dishes of any premium restaurant.  The flight, a Boeing 787, very aptly called the dream liner, was very smooth, gliding above the clouds, all through the little over eight hours it took to reach Delhi from Narita.   Since the air pressure in the air craft was maintained at 6000 feet compared to 8000 feet in other aircrafts there was more oxygen and higher moisture in the cabin, making one feel very fresh even after such a long haul flight.  I could get a good two hour sleep in flight on the seat which reclined to a flat bed.
Anyone with this experience will never be contented with anything less.  The AI hospitality indeed had a touch class.  Felt really proud to be an Indian.  I am very happy to recommend this flight to all discerning travelers.

title: Never, Never Again
text:
Having flown with Air India before and having a bad experience I didn't think that the second time would be as bad, how very wrong could I be. This journey was the compensation I received as Air India misplaced by luggage the first time I traveled with them, which I did not get it back for 4 days. 
This trip was booked over 6 months prior to us travelling and the seats reserved.
We booked in at Birmingham airport at 19:30 for our flight at 21:00 which went without a hitch.  The check in agent booked us through on all three legs of our trip which was via New Delhi and Mumbai. The first leg of our journey took us to New Delhi arriving at 10:30 local time the next day which was fine, just as it should be.  We transferred through IGI in Delhi without a hitch and caught our flight to Mumbai.  We went to check in for our last leg to Goa I was held me back while the rest of our party and everyone else boarded as there was a problem with my booking (remember I had been checked through in Birmingham the previous evening).  The surly check in clerk made a phone call and came back with my ticket with my seat reservation crossed out and a new seat handwritten on it.  The flight was late boarding so this hold up made it even later.  When I got on the plane I found someone else sitting in my seat.  I told the cabin attendant there was someone sat in my seat, but she wasn't interested either and said I would have to sit somewhere else separate from the rest of the group.  I asked how could my seat be reallocated after it had been booked 6 months prior and confirmed the previous evening at the start of our trip, guess what "not interested" This alteration that Air India caused now meant that the flight missed it's slot and was late taking off.  When we arrived at Goa airport we went to collect our luggage and I noticed the Air India ground staff waiting to deal with passengers complaints with their missing luggage forms in hand.  Not once did I think that my luggage would go missing a second time, how wrong could I be.  All the other luggage for our group arrived, except mine.  The staff at Goa airport could not have been anymore unhelpful if they tried.  Nobody was the least bit interested as this happens all the time, and did not seem bothered that I was without any of my belongings. I spoke to 3 different people and each was as uninterested as the last, even the station manager.  I was offered IR1500 as a payment for the inconvenience which I was told to collect on the way back through the airport on my return journey.  I eventually got this up to IR2000 as when this happened to me 2 years previously this is what I received.  If I hadn't argued I guess that someone would have kept this for themselves.
If you are considering using Air India I would seriously look at using different airline as Air India's service is very poor, and there are far better airlines out there to choose from.

title: Looked after me better than the British Embassy
text:
I duely booked my flights online to come back to the UK after almost 2 years away and ended up flying with Air India. My First Flight from BKK was on a new Dreamliner plane which was great, food excellent, staff very pleasant and entertainment options great - all was just perfect on the first stretch of my travel home. There was a transfer as part of my travel, so I had to change at New Dehli for a connecting flight to London - This is where the nightmare started - once getting off one plane you were then guided to yet another security area where your luggage and person were again checked by security, the International Transfers lounge was absolutely heaving and in front of me I could just see what looked like a never-ending mass of thousands of people, at this point I was a little worried that I would not get my connecting flight which was just over one hour away.

After at least 30/40 minutes of queuing up - I could finally see the security check area. It was amass with people all trying to get through what seemed like a very very lackadaisical approach to security, the Airport staff were joking about and being very very slow in their approach to security, it was disorganised and massively understaffed - everyone was very agitated - to be honest, the security area was diabolical and people started to jostle each other about at flight times were getting very close to the knuckle. I finally get to put my bag through the x-ray machine and have a body search, it was at this 'even more chaotic' part of the security area that I had my passport stolen - yes stolen in security!!! This meant I would miss my flight. The 'big boss' came to see me and i can only assume his team were watching CCTV to identify the person that took my passport - I was beside myself.
After 4 hours or so, i was paraded BACK to the International Transfers lounge - where i had been 5 hours ago and left - with the explanation that 'we will be with you in a moment sir'. Imagine - my phone only worked in Thailand, there are no food concessions, no shops, no ATMs, no internet - a lounge with just a frantic Air India team all working behind a large desk - I was in 'no man's land' and after another hour or so I was met by an Air India Official who explained that the forms that had been given to me by the head of the airport security dept to travel would not be sufficient as I am unable to fly without a passport, he was very kind and gave me some time to just explain my situation - which i would continue to do at least 15 more times to different officials. He beckoned me over to speak to the British Embassy in India, who were absolutely terrible, no help, no visit, no food - NOTHING, so I'm stuck, by now it was evening and i had been there since about 10am - I was offered food by Air India. to be honest, it wasn't anything to do with Air India, it was due to the erratic complete disorganization of the airport security department, that if proper due diligence was being employed, no one would have had an option of stealing my passport OFF THE SECURITY GUARDS DESK. I actually felt like causing an affray to just get arrested and then at least getting noticed, i sat there , in one chair for almost one day, with no phone/food/internet/money/contact with family (waiting for me at Heathrow, well, they were. I was then met by the head of Air India at the airport who asked me to relax and Air India would do everything in their power to get me home, starting with a trip to the High Commission in the morning and I was shown to a bed longer (where unfortunately building work was being conducted on the floor above, so no sleep there).
In the morning at about 7am I was greeted by a young, well turned out uniform - he had briefly spoken to me the day before and introduced himself (sorry I cannot remember your name) and he looked at me, held his hand out and said that my passport was in the possession of Air India - he went on to explain that the person was identified who took my passport and he was arrested at Birmingham International Airport where my passport was seized - given to the captain/cabin crew of the return flight and it was en route! four hours or so later I was reunited back with my passport (I can't tell you how that felt) I was then pulled to the front of a HUGE queue where I was asked which location I would like to fly back to in the UK - any destination and It would be taken care of by Air India - remember, this entire exercise was looked after by Air India, not security, not the airport, not the British Embassy - an airline - and to Air India, for their compassion and care - I am forever grateful. I arrived back in Heathrow where I literally wanted to kiss the tarmac!

text: We travelled around India for one month. We took 3 domestic flights: Jaipur-Mumbai, Mumbai-Goa, Goa-Mumbai. All 3 of the flights were delayed: 1 up to 3 hours. Staff wasn't helpful. We didn't get offered any water/drinks/snacks although they promised this as compensation. A lot of passengers missed their connecting flights and the airline didn't even apologize for the delays, which is unacceptable.

title: Comfortable, very good food, best long haul
text: Have flown to Delhi 3 or 4 times with Air India, reasonably comfortable even in economy, spare seats meant we could lie to sleep, good selection of films although not as many as other airlines for English speakers. Food is the main draw. Tasty mild curries, breakfasts and extras such as cake and cookies during the flight! Normally plane food makes me slightly nauseous but this was great! Good polite cabin crew and felt safe. Will continue to fly Air India.

title: Appalling experience.
text:
When they allow a guy to board who is so drunk out of his head that he is being violent and literally pissed himself whilst in his seat, you have to question the safety of the airline.

The customer service email address on their website doesn't even work.

There is NOTHING good to say about this airline and I am a frequent flier with gold cards on 3 networks. This is the worst airline I have flown with.

title: Satisfactory experince
text:
Overall decent experience, bit rough journey while landing. Food was nice and tasty! 
flight attendants are bit rough , you need to request them multiple times.

title: Terrible service but very well connected
text:
Pros include good legroom, excellent pilots and excellent connectivity across India.
Cons include older planes, hence older interiors and not so great food.

title: Air India rude staff
text: Extremely rude and very unhelpful air hostesses. Caused a lot of distress through the entire journey. Last minute we were told to move to another plane when it is a direct flight. No confidence in the staff !!!!

title: HYD -DEL Super Fly
text:
Lot of people have issues using Air India our National Carrier when i booked i was little worried about the service and other stuff but the seriously the service was really nice and are upto the level any other perimum flights, i was surprised with baggage allowance in domestic fly upto 25 KG no other flight offers you this much luggage
The food was really delicious and the flight attendants were very helpful ,i feel proud to choose Air India

title: Nice and comfortable flight to Mumbai.
text: Nice and comfortable flight to Mumbai.  Good connecting flight to Mumbai.  Leg space is good. Food serving was good. Staff is courteous. It's comfortable flight. Will prefer Air India flight for comfort and food options

title: Good Airline
text: Air India is good, better than low cost airline. Good food, good seats. Air Hostess needs to be more professional.

title: Possibly the worst flight ever
text:
We are waiting in Birmingham airport and we are told there is a delay, upon questioning a representative tells us "there is a problem with the plane, electrics, need a new plane or we are going to try and fix it."  This obviously doesn't fill us with the most confidence as surely an announcement to the rest of the passengers eagerly waiting would have been the most professional way to deal with the matter?! 

We eventually board the plane and sit down in what can only be described as outdated chairs with the internal cabin in drastic need of updating.  I think to myself ok well at least I can watch a film and relax right?.... Wrong!  The whole plane entertainment panels are down (guessing this was the problem), nothing was announced by the pilot or flight cabin crew regarding this matter, I asked an air hostess who just said to me "all off" and continued on.  

Next comes the food... I was asleep trying to avoid jet lag by adjusting to local Kathmandu time as was my wife, we both had ear plugs in and shut out masks, but this didn't stop the air hostess from waking us and asking if we want "veg or meat", I asked for meat and got veg I was too tired to argue so just eat it.  

Normally when disembarking the aircraft the flight attendants will normally smile and wish us well on our onward journey, but as we walked past they were ignoring us and starting to clean the cabin... 

I chose this flight purely by price, and as my mother taught me when I was younger "you get what you pay for".  

I would never travel with air India again and would advise all friends and fellow readers here to avoid like the plague.

title: Good flight connection from EWR-BOM
text: Their business class service is ok. Food is average and seats not as comfortable. However, the 4pm landing in Mumbai works well to get rid of jet lag. The return from Mumbai is also at a decent hour and you don't have to stay up all night.

title: Satisfactory for Short Flights
text: We had two flights on Air India in September and found both to be very satisfactory.  Both flights were on time with satisfactory service and a clean airplane.  We cannot comment on longer filghts but for short ones at a very reasonable price we would recommend this airline.

title: Air India Pilots  Worth Emulation
text: Pilots initive to brief the passengers to orient to geographical features, as one flies made the travel a memorable and extra ordinary experience .Such detailed briefing by AI Pilots are worth Emulation

title: What a mess.
text:
Check in was an absolute mess! Lines everywhere and not a lot of help from the check in staff.

The plane was dirty and has surely seen better days 

The meal service was alright but the crew mostly frowned and scowled at people. 

Air India has a lot to do if it was to be able to compete internationally once again.

title: Good hospitality and time punctuality but an air service itinerary without web check in facility in this modern age!
text:
Initially I have planned from Delhi to Hyderabad only & since my biz agenda amended I have booked this flight from Hyderabad to Vijayawada. While booking flight details appeared normal and with 90 minutes time lapse in between my Indigo Hyderabad landing and Air India Hyderabad takeoff in view that I can have my own boarding pass by web check in and can expedite an in lounge transfer. But Air India is stated that web check in is not possible and need to check in through counter only as the fight is share basis of Alliance. landing at Hyderabad coming out and going in & again check in at counter, messy tension and I am really surprising a reputed air lines like Air India is operating aircraft without web check in facility in this modern age. If so, it shall appear clearly at their own as well as other web sites while booking that web check in not possible. Accordingly passengers will choose their time lapse if they are coming from some other place. baring this constrain faced with  tension, other attributes like check in process, boarding, interior and cabin crew hospitality is excellent. More over, nice breakfast offered at cabin though journey is shorter in time.
I have posted my experience at Air India Facebook page but no response eceived

title: Awful experience
text: I used this airline to travel to & fro Delhi-Aurangabad twice in the last fortnight. Three out of the 4 trips I made, I was served the same food, a fact which I  brought to the steward's notice. This was the only direct flight available, so I had no choice but  to book this.

title: Angie V
text: Fortunately my Air India flight was without mechanical  incidents and I arrived to and from my destination without incident.  However I will never fly Air India again.  I found that the equipment (Movie screens, seat etc)  were in many instances not working or broken.  I had a 14 hour flight and the seats were poorly cushioned and uncomfortable.   The plane was not clean.  There was dirt caked on from years of not cleaning around the seats.   The flight attendants were at best distant not responding to call buttons  and/or border line rude.    Finally,  the laboratories needed cleaning during the 14 hour flight but never was.... so by the end of the flight there was toilet paper all over the floor and the bathroom was just disgusting!!  The flight attendants, rarely came to pick up trash so by the end of the flight, there was debris all over the floors.

title: Has come a long way..still room for improvement..
text: It is the cutest airplane ever I have seen. 😊😊..Basically a star alliance route,it was a very nice journey as far as flying experience is concerned.Snacks served were okay, but far better compared when I had travelled with air india last many years back .  Courteousness and punctuality requires little more attention. But a huge improvement. Long way to go our "Sarkari airline". All in all strongly recommended.

title: Day Time Dep/ Day Time Arrival.
text: You don't have to Rush around Early Morning or Late Nights at Odd Hours to travel by This Air India Flight. Very Convinent Evening Departure, You can A fruitful half day before flying, Say upto 2.00 p.m., Attending Appointments, Sightseeing, Working, Shopping, Lunching Or Brunching in New York., and Reach Airport. And More Often than not Flight arrives Early than Scheduled Time. .   .

title: National carrier experience
text: I love this aircraft. So I make it a point to fly this particular flight. This flight actually is from Hyderabad to Chicago via New Delhi. title: Air India

My First Air travel with Air India was truly good and i liked a lot.
the in flight services were really great.
polite and decent staff with courageous support.

title: Long Delays, No Communication, Wrong Display of Gate Number
text: Well, just like you would expect the service in any government office, the flight wasn't different. It was delayed by an hour already and I was communicated the same by their representatives. text:

text:
Quite atmosphere, staff nice and good looking, oriental smell all around and free bar after one our of flght, movies in many languages, more than on other companies: good flight...

title: Cheap but not great.
text:
At £496 this was the best price avaliable. Food was only just acceptable. Cabin was not as clean as other airlines I have been on. The entertainment system only worked on some of the seats. The cabin crew were only average.
We got there in just about comfortable conditions but I would not fly with this airline again.

title: Unorganized service put together without much planning
text: Being non stop was my major motivation to book on this flight on July 02. However apart from my purpose being served for a non stop journey, there wasn't much too offer for a business class passenger. Lounge was shared and menu options were limited for this airline. Heard lounge will be better soon as terminal will change. On boarding, it is an Indian tradition when someone is your guest then you serve some water or drinks soon. Noticed that wasn't asked on that day till you requested. The food service and quality could be far better. The seating space was good and seat was flat, but not all worked same way, not my next seat at least. The service overall looked unplanned and sloppy. The worst point of this flight was middle rows being curtained off with crew sleeping. I had read about it but now even experienced it. Looked very unpolished and ugly and major turn off. Probably those seats can easily be sold and revenues earned with alternate arrangements for crew to rest without compromising on quality and convenience. That space can also be put to better use like private cabins.  Observed some more issues since I  travel on business class on other airlines, so the difference was noticeable. Overall much can be improved. If non stop is not so important, then other airlines would be better option for business class.

title: Amazing

text: I use Air India for shorthaul trips to countries neighbouring Malaysia and longer trips within India. I find them very convenient, good and above all, competative. The service is good. Indian airports are vastly improved in recent years

title: Flight
text:
To be honest,  the is a new aircraft, the Dreamliner.
We were both looking forward to the experience, but it was a real let down
On the positive, there was sufficient leg room, and baggage allowance is good, 2 cases 23kg each, and the food was okay. Had a lot worse
The negatives,  this is a new plane,  the Dreamliner, which the travel agent was only to pleased to keep informing us, but the inside was, basically,  tatty.
The seat pockets in front of us were turn, and away from where it should have been,  not a lot, but noticeable,  the net pocket in front of that was also torn in a few places.
The on screen entertainment screen kept freezing and resetting, and also, whether there was a reason for it,  the planes global locations option was not working . At all.
Travelled on Emirates, Quantas, Air New Zealand,  and long haul, I like to see/know roughly what I looking at out of the window,  and the communications speakers in the aircraft were inaudible.   Not sure I'll fly this airline again

title: Poor maintenance of very old aircraft.
text: Too old aircraft and poor maintenance. Toilet seat material was worn out. Arm rest was shaking and did not have push button to adjust back of the seat.

title: Excellent Service
text:
Where to start and where to end.
Excellent Service, simply mind blowing.
I nearly missed my flight but both desk staff and security staff made sure i was in plane on time. Although I was travelling Economy class and was almost pissed off with my last Air India flight from Melbourne to Delhi and was very conscious about this flight.
But the moment i entered into plane, the staff was so helpful that they offered me a hand towel, moisturiser and a deodorant as i was sweating badly after running for almost 5 minutes to catch my almost missed flight.
Food was excellent, in-flight entrainment  was excellent but it was the service that made the difference. For a moment i thought i am travelling with Emirates or Singapore.
My question is why can't Air India keep the same standards in every route.
I guess it depends on flight manager and clearly we got some bad apples in other AI operated flights.
Nonetheless, I thoroughly enjoyed my flight and will definitely recommend AI from Delhi to Paris.

title: Dreamliner
text: The new Boeing Dreamliner really is a dream.   I recommend Row 11 in Ecocomy Class.    Check-in early to get best seat.

title: Poor Quality of Food
text: Travelled on 27 sep from Mumbai. The quantity of food served was very less, no tea or coffee option was there. Only Veg food was served. Even entertainment system was not serviceable. Attitude of crew in aircraft was not at all satisfactory. Need to monitor on major routes.

title: Entertainment System Not working

It is a very early morning flight so they have to provide blankets.
